# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 70 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 70

**1** Jesus said: "When you bring forth that which is within you, what you have will save you. If you do not have that within you, what you do not have within you will kill you."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- **ⲉⲧⲉⲧⲛϣⲁⲛⲧⲁⲗⲉ ⲡⲉⲧⲛⲧⲏⲩⲧⲛ** / "when you bring forth what is within you"
- The saying operates on a paradox: the inner content — brought forth or not — is both savior and killer
- "What you have" / "what you do not have" — the same inner reality is framed first positively, then negatively
- This is the Thomasine principle of exteriorizing the interior self as the path to salvation
- Parallels the parable of the talents in its structure of having vs. not having
- Unique to Thomas
